findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：非美國銷售地點占淨銷售約 36%；列出關稅、進出口管制、制裁及可能的對中國貿易限制為風險；美中關係與 USMCA 重新談判不確定可能衝擊業務。
findings.excerpt: government import and export controls, embargoes, sanctions or trade restrictions, including possible restrictions on trade and/or obstacles to conducting business in China

findings.claim: 2026 年 2 月美國最高法院裁定 IEEPA 關稅無授權；PH 於 FY2026 第四季認列 8,400 萬美元 IEEPA 關稅退款，沖減銷貨成本，另已申請較小額退款但未入帳。
findings.excerpt: During the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company recognized a reduction to cost of sales of $84 million related to IEEPA tariff refunds received from the U.S. government. We have applied for additional refunds under the same program, though for lesser amounts.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：ITAR／EAR 管制清單範圍變動可能迫使 PH 調整營運、取得額外許可或限制業務；違規可能失去出口特權。
findings.excerpt: Changes in export control lists or the scope of ITAR-controlled items may require us to modify our operations, obtain additional licenses or restrict certain business activities.

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未找到 PH 專屬的 Section 232 或實體清單披露；只做了 2 次搜尋。
